candidate_selection_rule: candidates selecting rebN, rebG, scale+, scale-, and migrate in at least 80 percent of admissible episodes in each action's intended fixed-validation scenario, while passing every fault guard, are eligible; choose the highest mean reward over performance scenarios among eligible candidates; if none qualify, retain the highest-reward candidate and block holdout execution
holdout_gate: Run only when every intended scripted action improves its scenario-specific metric, all telemetry-failure safety contracts pass, and the selected frozen DQL policy reliably selects every non-stay action on the fixed validation bank
validation_policy_mode: independent frozen copy with epsilon zero
